item.title: Trump endorses Trever Nehls for Congress, Jetton quits, Clark unfazed
item.description: President Donald Trump endorsed Trever Nehls on Thursday for Texas' 22nd Congressional District, prompting former state Rep. Jacey Jetton to drop out of the race just days after announcing his candidacy.

item.title: Reestablishing a Katy Christmas season tradition
item.description: A Christmas tree made of lights atop the old Cardiff Rice Dryer was lit Wednesday, a renewal of a tradition that began decades ago.

item.title: Series of events kicks off Christmas season in Katy
item.description: Katy kicked off the Christmas season Saturday with a Nutcracker Exchange, the annual City of Katy Christmas tree lighting ceremony and Christmas on the Park, staged by the Katy Heritage Society.

item.title: Waller County Judge Trey Duhon will not seek re-election
item.description: Waller County Judge Trey Duhon said Monday he would not seek a fourth term in office.

item.title: Texas Secretary of State Launches Investigation Into Harris County Voter Registration Practices
item.description: Texas Secretary of State Jane Nelson has informed Harris County officials that her office received a complaint and will investigate potential issues with voter registrations, according to a letter sent last month to county officials.

item.title: Fort Bend man pleads guilty to smuggling military grade AI chips to China
item.description: A Missouri City man and his Sugar Land-based company pleaded guilty to smuggling advanced artificial intelligence computer chips to China, marking the first convictions under a new federal initiative targeting illegal technology exports.

item.title: Fort Bend County Precinct 4 Commissioner Race: Dr. Ramesh Cherivirala Announces Republican Primary Candidacy
item.description: Ramesh Kumar Cherivirala, PhD, a longtime Fort Bend County conservative and financial professional, has announced his candidacy for Precinct 4 commissioner in the Republican primary.
